newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish c.bank drains 22 trln lira o/n at 56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish c.bank drains 22 trln lira o/n at 56 pct.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Turkish central bank drained 22 trln lira of idle cash at 56 pct o/n after brushing a high of 64.75 pct earlier. * The lira dived to 111,550 per dollar from 111,350 at open and 110,475 at Friday's close amid liquidity and the dollar's strength in world markets. * Bond yields edged higher in tight range in quiet trade.
